items.title: 56712_Cootie Williams oral history interview
items.q: I -- and I told him I wanted him. I offered him this money, and I stuck with him.

ctx.x: And that was what I wanted. And I heard him singing them blues. I -- and I told him I wanted him. I offered him this money, and I stuck with him.
Well, didn't you have a hard time? Because he had his dad there, in Houston, didn't he?
